Buyback Details: Portion of protocol revenue is used to buy back ETHFI, another portion goes to the Foundation treasury.
Value Accrual Details: Value accrues through programmatic buybacks held by the Foundation. Rewards are bought on the market rather than emitted
Economic Rights (Summary): 40% of revenue goes to Labs to cover expenses, 30% buys ETHFI on open market & is held in Foundation treasury, and 30% buys ETHFI on open market delivered to users as cashback rewards.
Treasury Details: A portion of protocol & re-staking rewards are directed toward DAO treasury, token holders can vote on treasury diversification activities.
Dividends Details: A portion of bought back ETHFI is distributed to users as rewards.
Burn Details: No burn mechanism is currently active
Revenue Details: Token holders can vote on economic parameters including protocol fees.
Fee Switch Details: After the DAO proposal passed in September 2026, Labs sends a share of interchange, swap and staking revenue, and the Foundation programmatically buys ETHFI by TWAP. 100% of eETH withdrawal fee revenue is allocated to weekly ETHFI buybacks.
Equity Statement: The Foundation stewards the treasury and executes token holder decisions, but does not collect protocol revenue directly. Ether.fi Labs collects 40% of product revenue. $32.7M was raised from investors across two private rounds. Ether.fi states there is no intention at this time to accrue value to equity holders via dividends or share repurchases.
Governance Details (Summary): Can vote on grants, parameters, protocol fees, controller, contract and various other protocol upgrades, treasury diversification activities
Brief description: ETHFI is the governance and utility token of Ether.fi, allowing holders to stake for a share of monthly protocol revenue from staking and restaking activities, vote on incentives and ecosystem support.
